name: @hector21/octoform
description: Declarative plan/apply governance for GitHub repositories: settings, branch rules, environments and files, from one YAML file
author: Hector Arrechea <hectorlazaroarrechea@gmail.com> (https://github.com/hector-ae21)

scripts.format: prettier --write src test scripts bin .github/workflows .github/codeql package.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.test.json typedoc.json eslint.config.mjs .prettierrc.json
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src test scripts bin .github/workflows .github/codeql package.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.test.json typedoc.json eslint.config.mjs .prettierrc.json
scripts.test:unit: npm run clean:test && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node scripts/run-tests.mjs
scripts.verify: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run test:source-policy && npm run verify:workflows && npm run typecheck && npm run verify:generated && npm run test:unit && npm run test:package
scripts.verify:generated: npm run api-docs:check && npm run reference-artifacts:check && npm run api-surface:check
